adjudication.basis: OptiqueVQS demonstrates ontology-based visual query construction over structured enterprise data, with coordinated concept/attribute/query widgets, textual SPARQL mode andquery catalogue/history. The protocol admits this implemented query-interaction prototype without requiring a deployed performance trial.

descriptions.interaction: Join concepts through relations, project or constrain attributes, manipulate the query overview, delete nodes, use the query catalogue, undo/redo and edit the textual SPARQL representation.
